posts.hook: The login system holding up DHS just became its biggest leak
posts.caption: a hacker claims access to dhs's okta login and leaked data on 41,000+ employees, google search growth slowed to 12%, the doj is asking about nvidia's hugging face deal. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: A hacker claims DHS's Okta login was breached, leaking data on ==41,000+== employees
slides.desc: The records reportedly show ICE and CBP facility locations and surveillance tool links.

terms.gloss: a service companies use to manage staff logins
US Customs and Border Protection, the border agency

slides.title: DOJ asks how Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face purchase affects AI competition
slides.desc: The main open model hub is now under antitrust review.

terms.gloss: the main site where open AI models are shared

slides.title: Google search revenue grew 12%, down from 14.5% a year ago
slides.desc: Google blames lower monetization in AI Mode, and is now taking ads there abroad.

slides.title: Samsung's HBM is sold out through 2027, and shares still fell
slides.desc: Capex jumps ~60% to ~$63B, and flash prices have quintupled.

terms.gloss: fast memory stacked next to AI chips

slides.title: Hidden browser extensions reportedly hijacked searches for 13 million users
slides.desc: Socket's report is a prompt to audit what is installed.

slides.title: Europe plans its first direct undersea cable to Greenland
slides.desc: The Pan-Arctic route could extend to Canada and Asia, bypassing the US.

posts.hook: Google's AI bet just got priced in, at half a trillion dollars
posts.caption: alphabet lost a record $500b in market value after earnings, doordash confirmed it is buying instacart for $17b, mistral released open weights for large 4. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Alphabet fell 12%+ on negative cash flow, a record ==$500B== drop in market value
slides.desc: Investors are now pricing AI spending as a liability, not just growth.

slides.title: DoorDash confirms it is buying Instacart for about $17B
slides.desc: This morning it was a report; now the two biggest US delivery apps merge.

slides.title: Mistral opens the weights of Large 4, a ~1T-parameter coding model
slides.desc: It says the model rivals top open models like GLM-5.3 on coding agents.

terms.gloss: the trained numbers that let anyone run the model themselves

slides.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to around 60,000 employees
slides.desc: It is cutting operating costs to keep AI infrastructure spending up.

slides.title: Short, small DDoS attacks are up 208% while giant ones fell ~69%
slides.desc: Cloudflare says defenses tuned for huge floods miss the new swarms of bursts.

terms.gloss: flooding a site with traffic to knock it offline
